name: appliqa-mcp-server
description: MCP Server providing AI agents real-time job discovery, ATS keyword match scoring, and career advisory tools.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search 50,000+ live verified job listings across LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor with filters for remote, location, and employment type.

query.description: Target job title, technology stack, or keywords (e.g. 'React Developer', 'Data Scientist')

tools.name: score_resume_ats
tools.description: Score resume text or skills against a specific job description to compute keyword match percentage, missing required skills, and ATS optimization advice.

resume_text.description: Raw text or extracted skills from candidate's resume

job_description.description: Full job description text or required role skills

tools.name: generate_career_path
tools.description: Generate step-by-step career progression ladders with milestone timelines and market salary benchmarks.

current_role.description: Candidate's current title or experience level

target_role.description: Desired next-level title or career aspiration

tools.name: ai_career_advisor
tools.description: Interactive AI career mentor for mock interview preparation, recruiter outreach drafting, and compensation negotiation tips.

context.description: Relevant job or candidate background context
